queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    count(*) as nb_stocks,
    round(avg(pe_forward), 1) as avg_pe_forward,
    round(avg(pe_trailing), 1) as avg_pe_trailing,
    round(avg(dividend_yield), 2) as avg_div_yield,
    sum(market_cap) as total_mcap,
    round(avg(change_pct), 2) as avg_change,
    round(avg(revenue_growth), 1) as avg_rev_growth,
    round(avg(profit_margin), 1) as avg_profit_margin
from market.stocks
where sector like '${inputs.selected_sector.value}'
